content.text:
Waived fees no longer count as owed, so the member is no longer refused at checkout and their account summary no longer shows the waived amount. All 61 tests pass, including the existing ones and one I added.

Checkout (`canBorrow`) and the member summary route both get the balance from `outstandingBalance` in `lib/fees/balance.js`. That function only skipped paid fees, so a waived fee still counted. It now skips any fee that is paid or has a `waivedReason`, which fixes both places.

The new test in `test/fees.test.js` waives one of two fees and checks that only the other still counts.

I didn't touch `payFee`. It still lets a waived fee be marked paid, which makes no sense for a fee nobody owes. Say if you want it to refuse waived fees.

My first attempt to write these files through a shell heredoc was blocked by the permission check. I made the same edits with the Edit tool instead, and nothing was left half-written.
